title: Theo and the Parish
author: Beatrix Sterling
blurb: Juniper Pemberton, an insurance investigator with a photographic memory, prides themselves on never taking a case they can't close. But when the missing person's diary continues past the date she disappeared, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must decode a ledger hidden in plain sight before the anniversary dinner raises its glass.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
